source.title: Demonstrações financeiras de 2025 e 2024 — Suzano S.A.
source.note: 4.4.1 — Administração de risco de taxas de câmbio
source.method: Manual transcription of consolidated 2025 foreign-currency exposure disclosure; independently reconciled by tests. Not an automated financial-statement ingestion pipeline.

limitations: Historical 2025 disclosure, not current treasury positions.
Exposure is substantially in USD, not necessarily exclusively USD.
A uniform proportional currency shock is an explicit approximation for non-derivative carrying values only.
Derivative fair values are not notionals or FX deltas and are excluded from the linear shock calculation.
Accounting remeasurement is not cash flow; export revenue, maturity dates, taxes, interest and future production are not forecast here.
No affiliation with Suzano; independent public-data study.
